method.walk_forward: calendar-year expanding window; only prior observations enter training
method.purge_rule: training feature dates within the boundary gap are excluded; every training label must end before test starts
method.embargo_note: post-test embargo is not needed because folds are strictly forward-only and never train on future observations
method.primary_loss: paired Brier loss: baseline(same signed streak bucket) vs conditioned cell
method.secondary_loss: absolute error of forward-return median prediction
method.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across every cell x horizon test within each index
